title: Slovakian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting beef stew originating from Slovakia, made with tender beef, velvety potatoes, and a hint of lime.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cubed potatoes, browned beef, slovakian paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine, then add the chopped velvety potatoes and lime juice.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
